display.title: Episode 113: A Diamond from Heaven, Chapter 1 (Adar)
display.summary_short: In the joyful month of Adar, Uncle Yossi explains why we treasure the Chumash and Rashi, and begins the story of Rashi's father and a priceless diamond.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the middle of Adar I 5744. Uncle Yossi opens with 'Mishenichnas Adar marbim b'simchah' and the Hakochainik march, followed by a sponsor. In a guessing game he reveals the sefer in his hand: Chumash Bereishis, the book Hashem Himself wrote, which we cover, never let fall and kiss. He explains how Rashi wrote his commentary so simply that a five-year-old can understand it, yet so deeply that great scholars find endless wisdom in it. A fourth-grade girl leads the Shema in Studio 604. Story time begins 'A Diamond from Heaven': Rabbi Yitzchak of France, a great scholar who supports his family as a diamond dealer, buys a magnificent diamond at a bargain. The governor's messenger offers full price, but Rabbi Yitzchak learns the stone is meant to adorn an idol. Fearing the governor's anger, he stalls for a day and pours out his heart in Tehillim, to be continued next week. The show ends with birthday greetings, a request to pray for a sick child, and Dial-a-Jewish-Story.
display.lesson: Treasure and honor the Chumash, and stand firm when faith in Hashem is tested.
